name: @suboney/commit-doc-agent
description: Local-first CLI that turns git commits into editable feature documentation.

scripts.demo:setup: npm run cli -- setup local --repo demo-project
scripts.demo:docs: npm run cli -- local --repo demo-project --ref HEAD --out demo-project/docs --store .run-store/demo-project-runs.json
scripts.dev:fixture: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js fixture
scripts.dev:local: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js local --repo demo-project --out demo-project/docs --store .run-store/demo-project-runs.json
scripts.prune:pack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); function walk(dir){ for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){ const p=path.join(dir,entry.name); if(entry.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(entry.name.endsWith('.test.js')) fs.rmSync(p); }} walk('dist');"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run prune:pack
